basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) is filling one contractual Instructor post in the Department of Bioscience and Biomedical Engineering. Indian nationals with a Ph.D. may apply by emailing a Scientific Curriculum vitae with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 4 December 2026. The pay is a consolidated minimum of INR 60000 per month.

qualification.details: Nationality: Indian nationals. Educational qualification: Ph.D. with thesis work in the area of Bioscience/Life Science/Biomedical Engineering/Devices/Instrumentation. Candidates who have submitted their thesis are eligible to apply. Expertise: the candidate must have expertise in the area of Bioscience/Biomedical Engineering/Devices/Instrumentation. Teaching load: the candidate is expected to teach six to nine hours per week or as per the requirement of the department, and will also be involved in conducting lab courses. Age: below 35 years. Age relaxation applies to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) categories, in accordance with government norms. The Institute may also consider further relaxation in age for candidates with exceptional qualifications and relevant experience, at its discretion. Pay: consolidated remuneration of a minimum of INR 60000 per month. An increased salary may be considered based on the relevant experience of the candidate. Duration: six months or till the end of project duration, whichever is earlier. The start date is December 07, 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The candidate's appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the said project as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer. The appointment may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance till date is not deemed satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Bhilai
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai is an institute in Durg district, Chhattisgarh. This notice, dated 15 November 2026, is issued for its Department of Bioscience and Biomedical Engineering. The post is a teaching position on contractual basis, and the appointment is tied to a project and its funding agency, which the notice does not name.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates who are willing to apply strictly on the terms and conditions of the notice may submit their Scientific Curriculum vitae with supporting documents by email to [email protected] on or before 4 December 2026. The notice does not mention a subject line or a separate application form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Nationality: Indian nationals. Educational qualification: Ph.D. with thesis work in the area of Bioscience/Life Science/Biomedical Engineering/Devices/Instrumentation. Candidates who have submitted their thesis are eligible to apply. Expertise: the candidate must have expertise in the area of Bioscience/Biomedical Engineering/Devices/Instrumentation. Teaching load: the candidate is expected to teach six to nine hours per week or as per the requirement of the department, and will also be involved in conducting lab courses. Age: below 35 years. Age relaxation applies to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) categories, in accordance with government norms. The Institute may also consider further relaxation in age for candidates with exceptional qualifications and relevant experience, at its discretion. Pay: consolidated remuneration of a minimum of INR 60000 per month. An increased salary may be considered based on the relevant experience of the candidate. Duration: six months or till the end of project duration, whichever is earlier. The start date is December 07, 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Instructor Job Description
content_sections.text: The Instructor would be responsible for the following: Teaching courses and conducting laboratory courses in consultation with the program coordinator and institute faculty. To help design and evolve the laboratory/lecture curriculum.

faq.question: Q1. How many Instructor posts has IIT Bhilai announced?
faq.answer: IIT Bhilai has announced one (01) teaching position of Instructor on contractual basis in the Department of Bioscience and Biomedical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai Instructor post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Bhilai Instructor post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. with thesis work in the area of Bioscience/Life Science/Biomedical Engineering/Devices/Instrumentation is required. Candidates who have submitted their thesis are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Bhilai Instructor post?
faq.answer: The candidate should be below 35 years of age. Relaxation applies to SC/ST/OBC and PwD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Bhilai Instructor?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is a minimum of INR 60000 per month. An increased salary may be considered based on the relevant experience of the candidate.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Bhilai Instructor post?
faq.answer: Email your Scientific Curriculum vitae with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an offline/online interview. The Institute reserves the right to conduct a written test if circumstances arise.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Bhilai Instructor post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual teaching position for six months or till the end of project duration, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the appointment be ended early?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance till date is not deemed satisfactory.
